failure_summary.description: Elliptical quotes, fragments, and name lists led agents to return a phrase category, count, or title detail instead of the person, work, or source intended by the clue.
The agent recognized that Hillary Clinton did not fit the Philippines clue but chose her anyway based on a partial date match.
Answers added specificity beyond the expected canonical labels, as in “Hallmark Cards” and “Sea lamprey.”

patch.reasoning: The main failure patterns overlap with relation-resolution and canonical-answer edits already proposed and rejected in this epoch. I am not repeating those ineffective edits or adding a narrower rule that would merely restate them.
